completeness.epistemic_limitation: A completeness declaration records the submitter's assertion and the inventory of materials supplied to the examination; it cannot prove that undisclosed documents, side agreements, or adverse records do not exist outside the submitted packet.

payload.current_status_rule: This immutable record proves issuance-time examination of the exact bound object. Current standing requires a fresh signed registry response and current trust/revocation information.

data_handling.deletion_policy: Registry records are append-only for audit lineage; buyers may request redaction of non-digest payload text where permitted by contract.
data_handling.retention_policy: Signed Standing Mark Record retained in append-only purchase registry; unsubmitted client data is never retained.
data_handling.storage_policy: Immutable signed result stored by purchase_id for buyer retrieval and recovery; temporary working buffers discarded after signing.
data_handling.training_use_policy: PROHIBITED — Wheeler Hubbell Publishing never uses submitted client data to train or fine-tune models.

decision_record.assessment_boundary: Single-door evaluation (/v1/evaluate): the deterministic Decision Integrity engine (The Continuous Work, version 7, encoded in code and pinned by hash) is the sole evaluator; no language model is invoked and no submitted data is transmitted to any external provider; the result is coupled with cryptographic Standing Mark signing.

checks.detail: Root hash, identifier and version must identify the same submitted object.
The assessment must fall within the requested time window.
An admitted source key must attest within its signed scope, operations and validity.
Non-active source versions cannot carry operative standing in this profile.
Source jurisdiction and scope must match the requested bounds exactly.
Source validity must contain the requested time window.
Every submitted source must be connected to the root; cycles and missing references are forbidden.
The requested operation must survive every source, warrant and unresolved blocking unknown.

emission.accuracy_over_fluency: Where material elements remain unresolved, the result names them rather than filling the gap (canon 955-962, 973).

named_missing_objects.why_it_matters: A claim that asserts an external source may hold premise-standing only with a retrievable source; without one it carries the standing of unknown (canon 955-956).

checks.basis: The proposition named at invocation is the object examined (canon 159-172); no substitute object is introduced by the examination.
A condition that changes meaning, burden, authority, scope, time, or permitted action is part of the element and must travel with it (canon 211).
Relations have independent standing; true propositions do not automatically authorize the inference asserted between them (canon 239).

A claim may exercise only the operation-specific force that its source, conditions, and warrant establish (canon 225). Access, confidence, and repetition do not supply decision-bearing standing (canon 475).
Every material transition must be expressly permitted by a governing rule or supported by an inspectable warrant adequate to the transition (canon 295-296).
An unresolved element retains the standing of unknown; no conclusion may borrow premise-standing from it (canon 391, 405).
Scope, temporal validity, and jurisdiction are conditions of a claim's standing (canon 321).
A record that was accurate in its time is not for that reason current (canon 897-899).

payload.integration_rule: A positive Standing Mark is a signed, scope-bound examination result. It may satisfy an evidence requirement defined by a receiving system, but it does not itself authorize an action. The receiving system must independently evaluate the applicable authority, conditions, and action policy. Absence of a positive Mark means the Mark requirement has not been satisfied; it does not, by itself, establish that the underlying action is prohibited.
